title: Differential Edge-Minus-Core Transport Calculation
key_question: Can the differential frequency shift between edge and core rays, after the shared post-absorber path cancels, be ~10^4 times the conformal-only shift without violating Cassini, cavity, and LLR?

conformal_differential.result: Conformal differential is ~1/3 of conformal shift. Standard scalar-tensor CANNOT produce 10^4 amplification.

disformal_transport.model: Path-dependent integral of (grad_phi_perp)^2 along photon chord

B_enhancement_at_transition.key_insight: B(phi) enhancement from field curvature is LOCALIZED to the screening transition. In the solar system, there is no screening transition (field is uniformly screened), so B_eff = B_0 and the Cassini constraint applies to B_0, not B_enhanced. This means the enhancement factor multiplies the allowed A_env by B_enhance.

conclusion: Standard disformal path integral: A_env max = 9.82e-07, required = 8996, gap = 9e+09x. With B(phi) enhancement localized to the screening transition: best A_env = 3.92e-01 (m_phi = 1e-30 eV). Cassini FAIL (enhancement is localized to transition, not present in solar system). The decisive question is whether the non-exact transport C_{T,||} has the structure of the standard disformal path integral (constrained) or a different, non-local/topological structure (unconstrained by Cassini).
